hardware_estimate_note: Contributor-reported 8-H100-per-node baseline; changed GPU count uses an ideal linear estimate. Calibrate on the deployment hardware/data before treating estimates as measured runtimes.
budget_note: Per-experiment active training time, including resumed/discarded work in its lineage. Compilation, data loading, checkpoint/export and final verification are excluded; wall watchdogs are separate. A time-limited checkpoint may score before one full epoch.
